rationale: The agent performed an order-modifying write (changed the air purifier and issued a refund) without authenticating the user, without verifying ownership of the order, and without confirming the change with the user beforehand. It also failed to follow the user’s requested sequence (check shipment status and cancel the item if not shipped before modifying). The refund to a specific gift card ID was done without retrieving or confirming the card from the user’s account in the transcript. Finally, the statement that no further modifications or cancellations can be made is unsupported by the tool outputs provided. These constitute clear policy violations, so the conversation fails.
